card.name: Just before psychiatric condition words
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts right before a psychiatric condition such as schizophrenia, anxiety, depression or mania, mostly in antipsychotic and antidepressant labels.

modes.label: Link before schizophrenia
modes.description: A short word like with, in or or sits right before the word schizophrenia or schizophrenic.
modes.example: fluvoxamine (25 mg b.i.d. for one week) on thioridazine steady-state concentration was evaluated in ten male inpatients<< with>> schizophrenia.

modes.label: Link before anxiety or depression
modes.description: The word and, or the start of anti-, comes right before anxiety or depression.

modes.label: Dose digits in psychiatric dosing
modes.description: A digit or gap inside a dose number in a dosing passage for a psychiatric drug.

card.writes: It seems to prepare words about emotional or psychiatric states (anxiety, dependence), though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a mental-health condition like schizophrenia or anxiety.
